description: Two-mode educational tool: (1) LEARN mode with a real-time animated canvas scene showing a raindrop's journey from cloud to impermeable rock — layer-by-layer underground reveal with water particle physics, and (2) MATCH mode — interactive matching of 5 groundwater terms to definitions. On completion, animated cross-section reward.
subject: Science
chapter: Chapter 7 — Heat Transfer in Nature, Section 7.4

learn.description: 5-step animated visual walkthrough with real-time canvas rendering

steps.title: The Water Cycle Begins
steps.visual: Rain clouds form, sky scene with Indian village (hut, well, tree)

steps.title: Infiltration
steps.visual: Rain falls, animated teardrop particles, dashed arrows show water seeping through soil layer

steps.title: Groundwater & Aquifer
steps.visual: Underground layers reveal — porous rock with 60+ animated water particles drifting through pore spaces

steps.title: Water Table
steps.visual: Pulsing orange dotted line appears at saturation level, well shows water reaching below it

steps.title: Impermeable Rock
steps.visual: Dense hatched rock layer revealed at bottom — water particles stop here

animations: Dashed infiltration arrows with falling animation
60 water particles with random drift physics in aquifer
Pulsing water table line with sin-wave opacity
Aquifer rock with elliptical pebble textures
Pill-shaped labels appearing at each step

match.description: Interactive matching of 5 terms to shuffled definitions

features.correct_match: Color-coded SVG connector line draws, green checkmark pops, pill badge shows term name
features.incorrect_match: Card shakes, contextual hint slides down in orange panel
features.completion: Celebration burst + animated cross-section canvas scene (step 4, all labels)

indian_village: Stone well with bucket and cross-beam

underground_layers.rendering: Brown gradient with scattered texture dots
Sandy brown with elliptical pebble pattern, 60 animated blue water particles

weather: Dark rain clouds with ellipse layering

teaching_notes: Activate AFTER the infiltration video and the aquifer diagram. The LEARN mode walks through the underground journey step-by-step with animations. Watch for the classic error in MATCH mode: swapping 'aquifer' and 'water table'. Clarify: aquifer = entire rock layer, water table = surface level of water. After match completion, ask student to narrate a raindrop's journey using all 5 terms.
instructions_for_student: Start in LEARN mode to watch a raindrop's animated journey underground! Step through all 5 stages, then switch to MATCH mode to test your knowledge. Match each groundwater term to its correct definition — 'aquifer' and 'water table' are tricky!
